summary: ResNexus engine read: every online site is a nightly full-hookup pull-through at $49.95 (Good Sam $44.95) Nov 2026 and July 4th 2027, plus 'Site Tax'; 50-amp FHU, showers/laundry/dump from the map legend; Good Sam rate offered (good_sam false->true); note-derived 49-site count cleared (map numbers 301-360). Pond ~3 acres behind the loop road: not waterfront stands.
flags: Price gate: $49.95/night pre-tax on the operator's ResNexus engine (every nightly site, same in Nov 2026 and July 4th weekend 2027) - 5 cents under $50; 'Site Tax' $3.01 is tax, the only add-on at checkout ($52.96 total). Good Sam rate $44.95. No gateway within 40 km (Branson 116 km). Presence: own site + phone + booking engine; Google 4.4 over 292 reviews; RV Life 4* over 100.

Long-stay: 'Monthly rates available' on the home page; 19 sites are sold nightly online (map numbers RV sites 301-360, so ~1 in 3) and 11 of them were free tonight - passes tests 2-4; no minimum seen; no homes. Not mostly seasonal on this evidence.

Waterfront (pond) stays not waterfront: the 'Private Fishing Lake' (Mockingbird Lake on the park map) measures ~115 x 140 m on imagery, ~1.3 ha / ~3 acres - under 5 acres, a pond; the nearest rows (336-341) have the campground's loop road and a walking trail between them and the water, and there is no pond-view value.
discounts.good_sam: the stored false came from the Good Sam directory (not a Good Sam Park); the operator's engine offers a 'Good Sam' rate ($44.95 vs $49.95), so set true from the operator's page.
